takeaway: AI's 'self-attention' mechanism means processing longer text isn't just a bit harder, it gets exponentially tougher. Doubling length quadruples cost!
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

AI's 'memory' doesn't just grow linearly; it explodes quadratically with longer texts! 💥

Here's the mind-blowing reality of how AI processes information:
🔹 When an AI processes text, every single word must calculate attention with every other word.
🔹 This 'self-attention' means if you double the text length, the computational effort multiplies by FOUR!
🔹 It's like inviting more guests to a party: conversations don't just double, they explode as everyone tries to talk to everyone else!
